skills.name: atptoken-onboarding
skills.description: Get an agent from zero to a working ATP Token integration — one API key, then OpenAI-, Anthropic-, or Gemini-compatible calls to text, image, video, audio, and embedding models. Read this first; it tells you which of the detailed skills to load next.

skills.name: atptoken-gateway
skills.description: Call the Atptoken LLM Gateway — an OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini-compatible API fronting many model providers behind one endpoint and key. Use when integrating with Atptoken, calling api.atptoken.ai, listing available models, or handling gateway auth, errors, and rate limits. Start here, then load atptoken-openai / atptoken-anthropic / atptoken-gemini for the specific SDK.

skills.name: atptoken-openai
skills.description: Call the Atptoken LLM Gateway using the OpenAI SDK or OpenAI-compatible HTTP API — chat completions, the Responses API, and streaming. Use when the user has OpenAI-format code/tools and wants them to run against Atptoken (api.atptoken.ai) with an atp- API key. See atptoken-gateway for base URL, auth, models, and errors.

skills.name: atptoken-anthropic
skills.description: Call the Atptoken LLM Gateway using the Anthropic SDK or Anthropic-compatible HTTP API — the Messages API, streaming, and count_tokens. Use when the user has Anthropic/Claude-format code and wants it to run against Atptoken (api.atptoken.ai) with an atp- API key. See atptoken-gateway for base URL, auth, models, and errors.

skills.name: atptoken-gemini
skills.description: Call the Atptoken LLM Gateway using the Google Gemini SDK or Gemini-compatible HTTP API — generateContent and streamGenerateContent. Use when the user has Google GenAI / Gemini-format code and wants it to run against Atptoken (api.atptoken.ai) with an atp- API key. See atptoken-gateway for base URL, auth, models, and errors.

skills.name: atptoken-image
skills.description: Generate and edit images through the Atptoken LLM Gateway media surface at /omni/media/v1. Asynchronous — POST /omni/media/v1/images/generations/tasks returns 202 + a task id; poll until terminal, then download data[].url within 24 hours. Every field except model is forwarded as-is, so each model family has its own parameter names (nano-banana image_size/num_images, qwen-image nested parameters with 1024*1024 sizes, gpt-image-2 size/quality/n) and its own place for edit input images (nano-banana -edit reference_assets, qwen-image messages). Use for nano-banana / qwen-image / gpt-image-2 and other image models via Atptoken with an atp- key. See atptoken-gateway for auth and errors.

skills.name: atptoken-video
skills.description: Generate video (text-to-video / image-to-video / video edit) through the Atptoken LLM Gateway media surface at /omni/media/v1. Video is asynchronous — create a task, poll until it is terminal, then download a signed URL within 24 hours. The model decides the body shape. Two client dialects (ModelArk-compatible and DashScope-native). Use for Seedance / Kling / Wan / HappyHorse / MiniMax video models via Atptoken with an atp- key. See atptoken-gateway for auth and errors.

skills.name: atptoken-audio
skills.description: Generate speech (text-to-speech / TTS) through the Atptoken LLM Gateway media surface at /omni/media/v1/audio/generations/tasks. Asynchronous — POST returns 202 + an aud_ task id; poll until terminal, then download the top-level audio_url (signed, 24 hours). Required fields are model and text. Use for fish-s2-pro / gemini-3-1-flash-tts via Atptoken with an atp- key. See atptoken-gateway for auth and errors.
